name: Shinra
description: One of Kyyrao's warriors who attacked Loot and was easily defeated.

timeline.summary: Kyyrao's warriors attack the dazed Loot and are easily beaten; the cat warriors nurse him back to health and Kyyrao takes him for her mate.
timeline.quote: Upon waking, Kyyrao took him for her mate.

timeline.summary: Loot attacks Dreadfang, who is soon dead; the party leaves the complex.
timeline.quote: Dreadfang did not believe, but was soon dead.

timeline.summary: Grover gave Loot, Kyyrao and Shinra provisions for their trip to the Peregrinator Complex.
timeline.quote: Grover provided them with no words of wisdom, but did give them provisions for the trip.
